answer: Every agent entering the harbor of this agent economy must post a slashable bond before it can earn anything, so each forged identity is a net liability instead of a free ticket. Reputation accrues as a slow pulse: each attestation from an established non-kin peer raises the score, while duplicate-identity detection drains the bond. At dawn each epoch, high-value work unlocks only for agents backed by enough such attestations, so a sybil farmer pays rent on every puppet yet earns nothing until real peers co-sign - making one forged identity strictly more expensive than one honest one.
